cards.title: The 402 is the checkout
items: No account, no card, no checkout page — the payment is the identity
The price is quoted on every request, so an agent buys the same way a person does
A $0 listing skips payment entirely and grants on the first GET

cards.title: Settle before grant
items: The payer is screened before any money moves
quote_id pins the terms: a mid-flight price change is a fresh 402, never a surprise
A purchase row exists only after a transaction hash does

cards.title: The receipt is on chain
items: The Base transaction is the receipt
A resent authorization is answered from the ledger, not charged again
Re-download any owned version later by signing with the same wallet
